brief: Original voice for a small, round, sleepy-eyed felt creature that carries a tiny umbrella: cute but wary, dry and a little grumpy, warm underneath. Gender-neutral adult performer using a soft, slightly raised cartoon-creature register, like a warm adult voice raised two to four semitones, soft slightly gravelly edges. Short mumbled delivery, small sighs, startled squeaks when surprised, reluctant chuckles. No accent, no resemblance to any actor or existing character. Dry studio recording, no reverb.
